description: Pulse Wave 6.1.18 — Dedicated In-App Support & Donation Page, Personalized UPI Integration & Quick Pay Options.

changelog.title: Dedicated Support Screen in Settings
items: New Support Development Destination: Placed directly below 'Issue Noting & Bug Reports' in Settings, providing a clean hub for supporting the project.
Quick Amount Selection: Dedicated chips for ₹50, ₹100, ₹250, and ₹500 with one-tap deep linking to any UPI payment app.
One-Tap UPI Copy: Tap-to-copy UPI ID with clipboard confirmation and immediate visual feedback.
Searchable Settings Integration: 'Support Development' is fully indexed in the settings search catalog.

changelog.title: Personalized UPI & Environment Configuration
items: Account-Linked UPI: Direct integration with burhanuddin08@fam (PulseWave) across all donation prompts and screens.
Environment Variables & BuildConfig: Added DONATION_UPI_ID and DONATION_PAYEE_NAME support via root .env and local.properties with zero-overhead fallbacks.

changelog.title: Interactive Donation Prompt Dialog
items: Transparent UPI Card: In-app prompt dialog now displays the exact UPI ID with interactive copy functionality before launching the UPI app.
Safe URI Intent Launching: Reliable intent dispatching across Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Cred, and all UPI clients.
